fixed_roles.caption: Five roles were fixed before final evaluation. The first panel shows the unweighted mean of five original-fold RMSEs with descriptive standard error. Fast-wind panels pool original windows conditioned on observed speed; misses remain included. No ranking or promotion is performed.

neural_feature_ablations.caption: Same fixed neural/tree recipe and seeds in every row: wind only, plus three ESP channels, plus six EUV lines, or plus both. Differences measure feature additions within this recipe; original windows retain duplicate weights.

classical_components.caption: Wind and EUV-line controls use the same 25% ridge/75% tree pair. The weighted row gives observed fast fitting cases raw weight four; H9 mixes 75% unweighted and 25% weighted line forecasts. Weights also affect HGB internal binning and gradient/Hessian scale relative to fixed L2.

paired_reference_skill.caption: MSE skill uses identical finite model/reference/observation cases for each cell. Zero is parity, positive favors the row model; a perfect reference makes normalized skill undefined. Conditions use observed speed in km/s.

detection_counts.caption: Hits=TP, false alarms=FP, misses=FN, correct quiet=TN on finite forecast/observation pairs. These are day/window counts with original duplicate weights, not independent high-speed-stream events. Paired counts and skill against both frozen references are in the CSV tables.

paired_final_uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap of fixed 54-day UTC bins
paired_final_uncertainty.sampling: Within each scope sample its occupied UTC bins with replacement, drawing the same number of bins; reuse every draw across all models, references and thresholds
paired_final_uncertainty.window_weighting: All original windows retained, including duplicate issue/target rows and their original multiplicity
paired_final_uncertainty.finite_cases: Each comparison uses one common finite observation/model/reference mask before thresholding on observed speed

paired_final_uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional uncertainty for a historical benchmark after adaptive model design; not independent confirmation and not used for promotion, tuning or selection

caveats: Folds 1-4 informed prior model design; all-fold averages are exploratory.
Original Fold 5 has already been opened in the earlier campaign; this is a locked comparison, not a newly untouched test.
Fixed earlier-champion recipe retraining differs from the separately retained old frozen selected pipeline.
Released WindNet forecasts are frozen references and are not retrained or selected here.
Present-day calibrated EVE measurements do not establish as-issued operational availability.
No tuning, adoption, ranking-based selection or new model design is performed from this final panel.
reading_notes: All displayed roles, ablations and thresholds were fixed before final evaluation; tables preserve fixed order.
Overall fold means and pooled fast-wind errors use different declared aggregations.
Negative bias means underprediction; negative paired RMSE differences and positive MSE skill favor the row model.
Mean-fold standard errors and bootstrap intervals describe this historical benchmark, not independent confirmation.
All EVE data are retrospective calibrated scalar measurements; no direct SDO image data are used.
